scope: Independent source-bound SPEC review of offline opening books, acquisition, provenance and validator only; not quality, neural-strength, UI, packaging, deployment or release certification.

checks.choices: Exactly eco, lichess-2200, lichess-2200-slow; eco remains unchanged default. Masters explicitly unavailable after preserved anonymous 401, redistribution rights unestablished.
checks.weighting: Independently replayed every selected game using strict Chess moves, not compileBook, and compared every runtime FEN, UCI move, absolute ply and integer game-frequency weight for both profiles. All match.
checks.offlineRebuild: Actual test rebuilt in memory, verifying retained source/evidence hashes and byte-identical artifacts/manifest/stats, without writing frozen book files or fetching source data.
checks.validator: Observed malformed/illegal/truncated/tampered rejection, complete SAN replay including beyond cutoff, bounded schema, exact serialized-position comparison and compatible runtime values for all three books.
checks.selection: Observed exact-ply and noncapturable-EP misses, transposition merge, deterministic/injected RNG, cutoff and terminal rejection. Existing candidate filtering checks legal moves.
checks.sourceRights: Preserved primary database.lichess.org grant explicitly covers CC0 commercial publication, modification and redistribution and links the exact monthly export. Parent separately reported fresh confirmation; this reviewer inspected preserved source, not a new grant-page fetch.
checks.license: Full 7048-byte shipped CC0 text matches preserved original hash; separately fetched official legalcode.en HTTP 200 and independently verified Statement of Purpose plus every substantive section 1-4 against shipped body. Did not refetch denied legalcode.txt.
checks.boundedAcquisition: Inspected fixed official URL, pre-network 200000000-byte cap, exact 206/Content-Range, streaming backpressure/hash/count, 120s AbortController timeout retained through full body consumption, partial cleanup and no explorer/auth path. Tests exercise ignored ranges, overflow, truncation and oversize rejection.
checks.localCompressedReceipt: Hashed existing ignored 100000000-byte prefix; SHA-256 10786e08ae7308ab12e3463154a66b061548d6610e5428b61c04a8b8e0807888 equals SOURCE and retained HTTP 206 bytes 0-99999999/29224520887. No reacquisition performed.
checks.completeness: Extractor requires explicit completed movetext result matching header and rejects unfinished, below-threshold, bullet and setup games. Prefix decompressor premature-end is not implicit game completion. Published encounter/completion/qualification counts remain receipt evidence, not independently re-extracted in this review.

limitations: Chronological compressed prefix and first 3000 qualifying games; not representative population or full-database popularity. Slow is a subset, not an independent database.
No Masters access, no Masters rights, no credentials, no endpoint retries, no paid calls.
Only retained initial 24 SAN plies replayed; no claim to validate unretained original complete games.
No full-body timeout elapsed-time injection or new live acquisition exercised in this review; timeout verified by source inspection.
Rating threshold is Lichess rating, not FIDE strength or title. Neither corpus choice nor game counts establish playing quality.
No UI/browser/build/CLI certification; parallel reviewers own those gates.
